missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: Find all products with stock count below 5 and retail price above $50, grouped by category

missions.name: Sizing Anomaly Identification
missions.query: Find all product styles with inconsistent size availability across different locations, grouped by size

missions.name: Supplier Delay Detection
missions.query: Find all suppliers with a lead time above 30 days and an on-time rate below 90%, grouped by country

missions.name: Reorder Point Breach Detection
missions.query: Find all products with a stock count below the reorder point and a stock count above 50% of the reorder point, grouped by category

missions.name: Product Sizing Pattern Analysis
missions.query: Find all product styles with a size distribution skewness above 2, indicating potential sizing anomalies, grouped by style name

missions.name: Supplier Country Risk Analysis
missions.query: Find all suppliers from countries with a high risk rating, grouped by supplier name and country

missions.name: Lead Time Variance Analysis
missions.query: Find all products with a lead time variance above 20% and a lead time above 30 days, grouped by supplier name

missions.name: Restock Frequency Analysis
missions.query: Find all products with a restock frequency above 10 times per year and a stock count above 100 units, grouped by category
